{{Top|leg}}
The '''Nagai grip''' was an enhanced [[Hilt/Legends|hilt]] for bladed weapons that was designed by the [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] in such a way as to improve a weapon's performance without adding any negative effects due to weapon modification. This grip had been available in two versions, advanced and superior.
